title: Last Gallery Diorama
details: 📅 Q4 · Unit 11 · Final Synthesis: Young Geographer-Citizen Exhibition

badge.name: Young Citizen Ribbon
badge.line: Only VR curators earn this one. You looked back on the whole year and told what kind of citizen you became.

hook.look: A work order is a note that tells museum workers what job to do next.
hook.head: Work Order 33 · Last Gallery Diorama
hook.alt: The words We the People in big old handwriting
hook.cap: "We the People," the first words of the U.S. Constitution, 1787. This year you learned how people live, work and govern together.
hook.note: This is our last work order. Please visit one more gallery and tell me what you became this year!

opti.brief: Curators, this is our last work order of the year. Visit one more gallery in VR, then record a short video about your year.
opti.collections: No headset today? Come to the collections room. Play the game, then tell me what you found.

voice.brief: Curators, this is our last work order of the year. Visit one more gallery in VR, then record a short video about your year.
voice.step1: Before your headset, read about the place. Then press Practice and say your two sentences before the timer ends.
voice.step2: Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type the map word, click the map, then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Move with the thumbstick. Walk through the gallery slowly, like a visitor. Look at the walls and the middle.
voice.step4: Open Library, then Camera. Click Record video and say your two sentences. Click again to stop. Then send it on the Canvas tab.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open the Canvas assignment and check that your video is there.
voice.extra: Have more time? End your video on the thing you like most in the gallery.
voice.collections: No headset today? Come to the collections room. Play the game, then tell me what you found.

vr.look: A gallery is a room in a museum where things are shown. This year you worked in our museum: maps, regions, trade, government. A citizen is a member of a community who helps it.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
@PLACE@

In your video, you say these 2 sentences:

@SAY@

Practice now. Say both before the timer ends.

@TIMER@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Centum in Filter environments. Click Optima Centum Gallery, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Scout the gallery
steps.html: Move with the thumbstick. Walk through the gallery slowly, like a visitor. Look at what is shown on the walls and in the middle.

steps.title: Record your video and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until the gallery fits.

Click Record video. Say your 2 sentences. Click it again to stop.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your video, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Record a new video and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your video is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: End your video by looking at the thing in the gallery you like most.

vr.full: One video, 30 seconds or less, that shows the gallery while you say both sentences.

place.alt: Two satellite pictures of a lake getting smaller
place.html: Remember the evidence: this year you used maps, photos and sources to tell the truth.
place.cap: Lake Mead from space, 2000 and 2022, from our Regional Council.

say: This year I became a citizen who ___.

studio.title: Spin the Year
studio.look: A wheel with six rooms from our year in the museum. Each spin lands on one room and asks one question about it.
studio.do: Tap Spin the wheel. Read the question. Tap the answer.

game.miss: Not quite. Think back to that room.
game.done: Six rooms, six answers! You are a young geographer-citizen.

slices.name: Exploration
slices.q: What did explorers use to find their way at sea?

slices.name: Maps
slices.q: What does a map key tell you?
options: What the symbols on the map mean
slices.ok: Yes! The key explains the symbols.

slices.name: Our Region
slices.q: Which places make up North America and the Caribbean?
options: Canada, the United States, Mexico and the Caribbean islands
slices.ok: Yes! Four big areas on one continent and its islands.

slices.name: U.S. Regions
slices.ok: Yes! The Southwest gets very little rain.

slices.name: Marketplace
options: Each side gives what it has plenty of to get what it is missing

slices.name: Citizenship
slices.q: In the United States, where does the power come from?
